+"""Generate and verify the frozen raise_platform trajectory.
+
+Run with: python /app/output/gen.py
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp
+
+from rcb_robowits import Session, mat_to_quat
+
+
+def generate(s):
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.reset()
+    book_pos, book_quat = s.object_pose("heavy book")
+    book_rot = Rotation.from_quat(np.roll(book_quat, -1)).as_matrix()
+    approach = book_rot[:, 0]
+    normal = book_rot[:, 1]
+    grasp_quat = mat_to_quat(
+        np.stack([normal, np.cross(approach, normal), approach], axis=1)
+    )
+    grasp_pos = book_pos + book_rot @ np.array([-0.03, 0, 0])
+
+    s.record_start()
+    p["open_gripper"]("right")
+    tip_pos, tip_quat = s.ee_pose("right")
+    p["move_ee"]("right", tip_pos + [0, 0, 0.22], tip_quat,
+                 linear=4, settle=20)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", grasp_pos + [0, 0, 0.2], grasp_quat, settle=20)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", grasp_pos - approach * 0.09, grasp_quat,
+                 linear=5, settle=20)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", grasp_pos, grasp_quat,
+                 linear=8, max_dq=0.01, settle=20)
+    p["close_gripper"]("right", steps=60)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", grasp_pos + [0, 0, 0.15], grasp_quat,
+                 linear=12, max_dq=0.012, settle=30)
+
+    # Keep the measured grasp transform while leveling the book in free space.
+    center, quat = s.object_pose("heavy book")
+    rotation = Rotation.from_quat(np.roll(quat, -1)).as_matrix()
+    tip_pos, tip_quat = s.ee_pose("right")
+    tip_rot = Rotation.from_quat(np.roll(tip_quat, -1)).as_matrix()
+    relative_pos = rotation.T @ (tip_pos - center)
+    relative_rot = rotation.T @ tip_rot
+    flat_rot = np.array([[1, 0, 0], [0, 0, -1], [0, 1, 0]])
+    interp = Slerp([0, 1], Rotation.from_matrix(np.array([rotation, flat_rot])))
+    for t in np.linspace(0, 1, 10)[1:]:
+        rot = interp(t).as_matrix()
+        target_center = center * (1 - t) + np.array([0.52, -0.02, 1.04]) * t
+        p["move_ee"]("right", target_center + rot @ relative_pos,
+                     mat_to_quat(rot @ relative_rot), max_dq=0.012, settle=10)
+
+    flat_quat = mat_to_quat(flat_rot @ relative_rot)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", np.array([0.64, 0, 1.04]) + flat_rot @ relative_pos,
+                 flat_quat, linear=10, max_dq=0.015, settle=20)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", np.array([0.64, 0, 0.89]) + flat_rot @ relative_pos,
+                 flat_quat, linear=15, max_dq=0.012, settle=40)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", np.array([0.64, 0, 0.875]) + flat_rot @ relative_pos,
+                 flat_quat, linear=5, max_dq=0.01, settle=60)
+    p["open_gripper"]("right", steps=60)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.47, -0.01, 0.885], flat_quat,
+                 linear=10, max_dq=0.012, settle=60)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.45, -0.2, 1.10], flat_quat,
+                 linear=6, settle=60)
+    p["hold"](300)
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    assert s.status()["success"], s.status()
+    return actions
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    output = Path("/app/output")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    session = Session("raise_platform", instance="/app/instance.json")
+    actions = generate(session)
+    first = session.replay(actions)
+    assert first["success"], first
+    session.save_trajectory(actions, output / "trajectory.npz")
+    second = session.replay(actions)
+    assert second["success"], second
+    print({"actions": len(actions), "replay_1": first, "replay_2": second})
*** End Patch"));
